lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Which squad will it be?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You mean the supporting unit?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Considering that Matis has just been revived,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: they wouldn't be redeployed so soon after.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think Syuen will try to take advantage of all the eyes that are on Matis right now.
What about M.M.R.?
Maybe Wardress will be deployed.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Who knows?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Although I've never seen a single member

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: venture outside of that research institute.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Me neither.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Actually, are they even allowed to leave that place?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Who knows?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They're responsible for capturing Raptures,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: not going out on search expeditions.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Actually, the Scouts would probably be

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: the most appropriate for the job.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah, you're probably right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The Scouts aren't manufactured by Missilis,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but if Syuen can swallow her pride for one second and ask Ingrid for a favor,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm sure she'd be willing to oblige.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The only thing is,

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: you know perfectly well Syuen can't do that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: that's not her style.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Jeez,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: is her pride really so important to her?
Don't think about it too much.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No matter which squad ends up being our support, it'll be better than nothing.
